hero.title: Bitcoin ETFs sink into October outflows with $643M exit after Binance hack
hero.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs ended October with $515 million in net withdrawals, while Ether funds posted a record $1.61 billion in monthly outflows.

latest.title: AI is coming to construction sites. But does it make workers safer?
latest.description: AI is flagging hazards on construction sites, but researchers say evidence that the technology prevents injuries remains limited.

latest.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $643 million in outflows Friday, and 2026 is barely green now
latest.description: The first trading day after the Binance hack saw the biggest ETF outflow since June 25.

latest.title: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget
latest.description: The 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, and will include a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.

latest.title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet thefts running on outdated software
latest.description: BTCPay Server urged operators to shut down their servers after receiving reports of unauthorized attackers draining funds from hot wallets.

latest.title: Strangers are begging the Binance hacker for bitcoin, one ‘help me bro’ at a time
latest.description: The 19 wallets holding 18,270 stolen BTC have taken in nothing since Thursday except payments worth under a dollar, each carrying a message, from pleas to laundering pitches to a token shill.

latest.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows as withdrawals resume after massive hack
latest.description: Binance recorded $3.64 billion in net outflows after resuming withdrawals following a $6.3 billion hack, representing 2.1% of its total assets.

latest.title: Bitcoin claws back toward $79,000 as markets shake off crypto's biggest hack
latest.description: ZEC led the majors and oil slid on a report that Trump wants to give Iran diplomacy more time, with U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday.

latest.title: BTCPay, a bitcoin payment tool, tells users to switch off their servers after reports of drained wallets
latest.description: The open-source project says it is still investigating and hasn't given a loss figure or announced a fix. Its founder said the reports appear to involve versions older than 2.4.2.

latest.title: Canada-India $5.5 billion bank takeover attracts opposition from workers, politicians
latest.description: IDBI workers demand the government "cancel the privatization process" and work to strengthen the bank while protecting public investment and staff interests.

latest.title: Bank of Korea probes financial firms’ exposure to crypto risks
latest.description: The central bank is surveying 31 financial institutions on how a major exchange shutdown, prolonged crypto downturn or losses at another firm could affect their operations.

latest.title: Sam Altman makes surprise South Korea visit as OpenAI builds on chip partnerships
latest.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman made an unannounced visit to South Korea over the weekend, meeting with Samsung executives and reportedly SK Group executives.

latest.title: Rubio says Trump wants to end Iran war 'peacefully' even as both sides prepare for strikes
latest.description: The remarks come as reports suggest that both sides are gearing up for additional military strikes after the U.S. midterm elections.

latest.title: THORChain halts swaps after block reorg bug, slowing Binance hackers
latest.description: THORChain node operators paused swaps involving assets on 10 networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Tron.

latest.title: Binance net outflows surge to $5.8B as withdrawals resume after record hack
latest.description: The exchange says withdrawals surged after some services resumed but have since slowed, with the outflows representing a fraction of its roughly $171 billion in customer assets.

latest.title: Judge dismisses Alaska Senate election lawsuit; DOJ vows appeal
latest.description: Democratic nominee Mary Peltola is facing two candidates named Dan Sullivan in the Alaska Senate election, one of whom is the Republican incumbent.

latest.title: THORChain founder rejects freeze request, CZ thanks Secret Service: Hodler’s Digest
latest.description: Binance has reopened withdrawals following the world’s biggest ever hack, and THORChain co-founder argues it should not halt the protocol to comply with FBI demands.

latest.title: Democratic Rep. Stevens endorses Republican Rogers over rival El-Sayed in Michigan Senate election
latest.description: Haley Stevens had lost the Democratic nomination for Senate in Michigan to Abdul El-Sayed earlier this year.

latest.title: The crypto reader's guide to the 2026 midterm election: State of Crypto
latest.description: America is going to the polls, and the results will shape crypto legislation and regulation over the next two years. Here's what to know.

latest.title: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy has stroke and is in the hospital, office says
latest.description: Sen. Chris Murphy's office announced Sunday that he suffered a stroke and was hospitalized the day prior, though they say he is 'awake and alert.'
